coreMemory.english: n. an act or possibility of choosing
coreMemory.structure: make a choice /ˈmeɪk ə tʃɔɪs/（作出选择）；have no choice /ˈhæv ˈnoʊ tʃɔɪs/（别无选择）；a good choice /ə ˈɡʊd tʃɔɪs/（好选择）；choice between /tʃɔɪs bɪˈtwiːn/（……之间的选择）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use choice with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of choice in context；❌ translate choice word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “make a choice”

commonErrors.wrong: use choice with the same article in every context

commonErrors.right: check the countability of choice in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈtʃɛk ðə countability ˈʌv tʃɔɪs ɪn ˈkɑntɛkst/

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “make a choice”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈlɝːn ðə kəˈmpliːt ˈfreɪz ˈmeɪk ə tʃɔɪs/

fixedPhrases.example: You need to make a choice before noon.
fixedPhrases.translation: 你需要在中午前作出选择。

fixedPhrases.example: We had no choice but to wait.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们别无选择，只能等待。

fixedPhrases.example: Taking the earlier train was a good choice.
fixedPhrases.translation: 乘较早的火车是个好选择。

fixedPhrases.example: It is a choice between saving time and saving money.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这是在节省时间和节省金钱之间作选择。

fixedPhrases.example: She works part-time by choice.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她自愿选择做兼职。

fixedPhrases.example: This course was my first choice.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这门课程是我的首选。
